name: github-bot
description: Connect Kettu Bots to GitHub Issues and Pull Requests via @kettu-bots mentions over an outbound WebSocket without storing code or prompts in the cloud.

description.en: Receive @kettu-bots mentions on GitHub Issues and PRs over an outbound WebSocket and reply according to each Bot's policy.
description.zh-CN: 通过出站 WebSocket 接收 GitHub Issue 与 PR 中的 @kettu-bots 提及，并按策略回帖。

settings.title: Connector URL (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty to use Kettu Cloud Connector (https://connectors.kettu.sh), or enter your self-hosted connector URL.

description.en: Forwards @kettu-bots mentions on Issues and PRs over outbound WebSocket without storing code or prompts.
description.zh-CN: 通过出站 WebSocket 转发 @kettu-bots 提及，云端不落盘代码与提示词。

description.en: Cloud Connector connection state and linked GitHub account.
description.zh-CN: Cloud Connector 连接状态与已绑定的 GitHub 账号。
